messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners and timing for customer comms and RCA access. Who can drive statuspage wording and the 72h public summary?

maria: I can take statuspage copy. Suggest: 'We experienced a service disruption affecting generation latency. Mitigation in place; full analysis underway. Customers with affected requests will be contacted.' Short and non-technical. :white_check_mark:

liz: +1 on short copy. Two things: 1) we need a private 72h internal summary for customers with PII concerns, 2) define when we can publish the full RCA vs. share privately.

jordan: For timelines, ops suggestion: 72h internal summary (high level, timeline, impact), RCA draft by 7 business days, public RCA by 14 business days unless we need to redact vendor-sensitive details. Customers who request earlier access get a redacted private RCA after legal review.

alex: OK that matches what I had in mind. Can we list concrete action items and owners here so it gets tracked? Also want to note pattern: this is the third degraded-latency incident in ~2 months — need recurring-incident mitigation owner.

maria: Action 1: Statuspage copy + publish — owner: maria — ETA: 1h. Action 2: 72h customer summary (internal & customer-facing variants) — owner: jordan — ETA: 72h. Action 3: Full RCA draft — owner: liz — ETA: 7d. Action 4: Recurring incidents deep-dive and mitigation plan — owner: alex — ETA: 14d.

liz: Legal review required for any RCA that includes third-party vendor attribution or customer-specific logs. Looping in @sam for review timing.

sam: Got it. I can do a 24h turnaround on redaction review for the 72h summary; full RCA review may take up to 3 business days depending on scope. Please tag as: `legal-review` in tracker.

ops-bot: Action created: PM-789 | owner:maria | due: +1h
ops-bot: Action created: PM-790 | owner:jordan | due: +72h
ops-bot: Action created: PM-791 | owner:liz | due: +7d
ops-bot: Action created: PM-792 | owner:alex | due: +14d

maria: Draft statuspage posted in #incidents-drafts: https://go/internal/statuspage-draft — feedback welcome.
jordan: For the customer-facing 72h summary I'll prepare two variants: (A) automated email snippet for self-serve customers, (B) personalized note for enterprise customers. Will include list of affected endpoints and mitigation steps, but no raw logs.
liz: We should add a short FAQ bullet to statuspage about how customers can request a private RCA. Suggested text: 'To request a detailed RCA for your account, open a support ticket and select "Incident RCA" — we will respond within 3 business days.'
alex: Good. Last item: recurring pattern — alex will set up a small working group (SRE + Runtime + ML infra) to propose concrete mitigations (KV cache tuning, routing fallback tweaks, batching thresholds). Will add owners in PM-792.
maria: I'll publish statuspage update once legal signs off on the 72h wording.
sam: Please cc legal@redwood when you post the draft so I get notified.
jordan: Noted. I’ll post the 72h internal summary to the incident doc and ping owners.
alex: Thanks all — recording these owners in the postmortem tracker. If anyone needs to reassign, update the PM tickets rather than replying here. :thumbsup:
